intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.10.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 10.90 MB binary -26.3%, 57.7 KB gzip shell, 34.03ms pinned cold boot -94.2% vs v1.8.0, 17.22 MB RSS -85.0% vs v1.2.0, 1-Click Launch Autopilot Fix All Failing Checks + CRC-32 Export Ready .rbxlx/.zip, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, and 4,444 req/s 16w pinned with 4.53ms p95), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.8.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with Inline Worktree Diff Peek & CWE-22/CWE-59 confinement, Board Quick-Filters & Wave Digest, #seq Quote-Reply, native zlib.crc32 ETag, and 93.1 KiB gz / 72.72 MB --jitless RSS / 24.65ms max tail -93.8% / 28/28 fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.19.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 9.31 MB binary -41.8% vs v0.10.0, 18.73 MB RSS -15.4%, 4,703.8 req/s +161.1% via HTTP/1.1 Keep-Alive + -O3 hot-path split + O(limit) search, 4.53ms p95 -72.8%, 1-Click Multi-Run Client Summary Pack .md/.html, Citation Freshness Pre-Flight Gate, Verified Client Handoff .html, and Unified Fuzzy Cmd+K).
